description: This file defines configuration arrays for unit testing, including include patterns, boundary test files, and exclude patterns for a JavaScript/TypeScript project. It also contains utility functions to determine if a given file matches certain test criteria.

methods.name: isUnitConfigTestFile
methods.description: Determines whether a given file matches the include patterns for unit configuration tests, excluding certain patterns.

methods.name: isBundledPluginDependentUnitTestFile
methods.description: Checks if the file is among the list of bundled plugin-dependent unit test files.

methods.name: isBoundaryTestFile
methods.description: Checks if the file is listed as a boundary test file.
